# spring-boot

Spring MVC conventions the adapter extracts (annotations, validation, Jackson) plus the Boot x Java compatibility guard.

## Detected anti-patterns

### `AF-CODE-001` — Duplicate code route (medium)

Two handlers bound to the same method and path make the served behavior depend on registration order.

Remediation: Keep a single handler per method/path pair or give them distinct paths.

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-design.md

### `AF-CODE-002` — Code route missing from contract (medium)

A served route absent from the contract is invisible to generated clients and undocumented to consumers.

Remediation: Add the operation to the contract or remove the route.

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-design.md

### `AF-CODE-003` — Route could not be resolved statically (low)

A dynamic route expression keeps the inventory incomplete, so presence or absence findings near it cannot be confirmed.

Remediation: Replace the dynamic expression with a literal path or register the route through a static include.

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-design.md
